meta.name: fluidsim
meta.description: Plan, configure, inspect, restart, and analyze bounded FluidSim computational-fluid-dynamics simulations with explicit numerical-validity and HPC safety checks. Use for FluidSim solver selection, parameter review, FFT/MPI setup, output diagnostics, or restart compatibility.

copy.tagline: 规划配置计算流体动力学仿真，进行数值有效性与HPC安全检查
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在做流体动力学仿真，需要确保计算参数有效
copy.tagline_en: Plan, configure, and analyze FluidSim CFD simulations with validity and HPC safety checks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you conduct fluid dynamics simulations and need to ensure numerical validity and HPC safety

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能帮你规划、配置、检查、重启 FluidSim 流体模拟,包含数值有效性和 HPC 安全检查;可选用对应求解器、设参数、运行并分析输出(如速度场、涡量、能谱)。
howto.when: 当用户要求运行流体动力学模拟(如 2D/3D Navier-Stokes、浅水、分层流等),或进行湍流/涡旋分析,或需要选求解器、配 FFT/MPI、检查/重启模拟时触发。

say.text: 检查这个模拟的参数设置是否有效,然后重启它。
say.note: 检查数值有效性和重启兼容性。

say.text: 分析我保存的模拟输出,画出涡量和一维能谱。
say.note: 加载 HDF5 数据并绘图。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can help you plan, configure, inspect, and restart FluidSim CFD simulations, with numerical-validity and HPC safety checks; it selects solvers, sets parameters, runs simulations, and analyzes outputs such as velocity fields, vorticity, and spectra.
howto.when_en: Triggered for fluid dynamics runs (2D/3D Navier-Stokes, shallow water, stratified), turbulence/vortex analysis, or solver selection, FFT/MPI setup, output diagnostics, or restart.

say_en.text: Set up ns2d with a 256×256 grid, viscosity 1e-4, and run for 50 time units.
Check parameter validity and restart this simulation.
say_en.note: Checks numerical validity and restart compatibility.

say_en.text: Analyze saved outputs and plot vorticity and 1D spectra.
